final class ContributionWorkflow
{
    public function __construct(private PDO $pdo) {}

    public static function parseAmount(mixed $raw): string
    {
        $s = preg_replace('/\s|R\$/u', '', trim((string)$raw)) ?? '';
        if (preg_match('/^[0-9]{1,3}(?:\.[0-9]{3})+(?:,[0-9]{1,2})?$/D', $s)) {
            $s = str_replace(',', '.', str_replace('.', '', $s));
        } elseif (preg_match('/^[0-9]{1,8}(?:,[0-9]{1,2})?$/D', $s)) {
            $s = str_replace(',', '.', $s);
        }
        if (!preg_match('/^[0-9]{1,8}(?:\.[0-9]{1,2})?$/D', $s)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Informe um valor válido em reais.');
        }
        $value = (float)$s;
        if ($value <= 0 || $value > 99999999.99) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('O valor precisa ser positivo e dentro do limite.');
        }
        return number_format($value, 2, '.', '');
    }

    public function enable(string $churchId, bool $enable): void
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT id,contribution_quick_token FROM churches WHERE id=? AND active=1 LIMIT 1');
        $stmt->execute([$churchId]);
        $church = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        if (!$church) throw new RuntimeException('Igreja inválida.');
        if ($enable) {
            $this->seedCatalog($churchId);
            $token = $church['contribution_quick_token'] ?: bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
            $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE churches SET contribution_quick_enabled=1,contribution_quick_token=? WHERE id=?')
                ->execute([$token,$churchId]);
        } else {
            $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE churches SET contribution_quick_enabled=0 WHERE id=?')
                ->execute([$churchId]);
        }
    }

    public function rotateToken(string $churchId): void
    {
        $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE churches SET contribution_quick_token=? WHERE id=?')
            ->execute([bin2hex(random_bytes(32)), $churchId]);
    }

    public function seedCatalog(string $churchId): void
    {
        $types = [
            ['dizimo','Dízimo',0,0],['oferta','Oferta',0,0],
            ['missoes','Missões',0,0],['campanha','Campanha',0,1],
            ['doacao','Doação',0,0],['outro','Outro',0,0],
        ];
        $payments = [
            ['pix','Pix',1,0],['dinheiro','Dinheiro',0,0],
            ['transferencia','Transferência',1,0],['cartao','Cartão',0,0],
        ];
        $sql = 'INSERT IGNORE INTO contribution_catalog(id,church_id,kind,code,name,requires_reference,requires_campaign,sort_order) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)';
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        foreach (['type'=>$types,'payment'=>$payments] as $kind=>$rows) {
            foreach ($rows as $i=>$r) {
                $stmt->execute([app_uuid(),$churchId,$kind,$r[0],$r[1],$r[2],$r[3],$i]);
            }
        }
    }

    public function catalog(string $churchId,string $kind): array
    {
        if (!in_array($kind,['type','payment'],true)) throw new InvalidArgumentException('Lista inválida.');
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT id,code,name,requires_reference,requires_campaign,requires_proof,allow_anonymous FROM contribution_catalog WHERE church_id=? AND kind=? AND active=1 ORDER BY sort_order,name');
        $stmt->execute([$churchId,$kind]);
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }

    public function campaigns(string $churchId, ?string $date = null): array
    {
        $date ??= date('Y-m-d');
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT id,name,contribution_type_id FROM contribution_campaigns WHERE church_id=? AND active=1 AND start_date<=? AND (end_date IS NULL OR end_date>=?) ORDER BY name');
        $stmt->execute([$churchId,$date,$date]);
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }

    public function addCampaign(string $churchId,array $input): string
    {
        $name = trim((string)($input['name']??''));
        $start = (string)($input['start_date']??'');
        $end = trim((string)($input['end_date']??'')) ?: null;
        self::date($start);
        if ($end !== null) self::date($end);
        if ($name===''||mb_strlen($name)>160||($end!==null&&$end<$start)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Informe nome e datas válidos da campanha.');
        }
        $typeId=trim((string)($input['contribution_type_id']??''))?:null;
        $responsible=trim((string)($input['responsible_user_id']??''))?:null;
        $center=trim((string)($input['cost_center_id']??''))?:null;
        $purpose=trim((string)($input['purpose']??''))?:null;
        if($purpose!==null && mb_strlen($purpose)>250)throw new InvalidArgumentException('Finalidade excede 250 caracteres.');
        if($typeId!==null){
            $q=$this->pdo->prepare("SELECT id FROM contribution_catalog WHERE id=? AND church_id=? AND kind='type' AND active=1");
            $q->execute([$typeId,$churchId]);
            if(!$q->fetchColumn())throw new InvalidArgumentException('Tipo de contribuição inválido nesta igreja.');
        }
        if($responsible!==null){
            $q=$this->pdo->prepare('SELECT user_id FROM church_members WHERE church_id=? AND user_id=?');
            $q->execute([$churchId,$responsible]);
            if(!$q->fetchColumn())throw new InvalidArgumentException('Responsável não pertence a esta igreja.');
        }
        if($center!==null){
            $q=$this->pdo->prepare("SELECT id FROM church_registers WHERE church_id=? AND id=? AND kind='cost_center' AND active=1");
            $q->execute([$churchId,$center]);
            if(!$q->fetchColumn())throw new InvalidArgumentException('Centro de custo inválido nesta igreja.');
        }
        $id=app_uuid();
        $this->pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO contribution_campaigns
            (id,church_id,name,start_date,end_date,active,contribution_type_id,responsible_user_id,cost_center_id,purpose)
            VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,1,?,?,?,?)')
            ->execute([$id,$churchId,$name,$start,$end,$typeId,$responsible,$center,$purpose]);
        return $id;
    }

    private static function date(string $date): void
    {
        $d=DateTimeImmutable::createFromFormat('!Y-m-d',$date);
        if (!$d || $d->format('Y-m-d')!==$date) throw new InvalidArgumentException('Informe uma data válida.');
    }

    public function publicChurch(string $token): ?array
    {
        if (!preg_match('/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/D',$token)) return null;
        $stmt=$this->pdo->prepare('SELECT id,name,logo_url,brand_primary,brand_secondary,brand_tagline,contribution_quick_token FROM churches WHERE contribution_quick_token=? AND contribution_quick_enabled=1 AND active=1 LIMIT 1');
        $stmt->execute([$token]);
        return $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: null;
    }

    private function item(string $churchId,string $kind,string $id): array
    {
        $stmt=$this->pdo->prepare('SELECT id,code,name,requires_reference,requires_campaign,requires_proof,allow_anonymous FROM contribution_catalog WHERE id=? AND church_id=? AND kind=? AND active=1 LIMIT 1');
        $stmt->execute([$id,$churchId,$kind]);
        $row=$stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        if (!$row) throw new InvalidArgumentException('Tipo ou forma de entrega inválida nesta igreja.');
        return $row;
    }

    /**
     * Public submission only reports an intention/contribution.
     * It does NOT credit the treasury before human confirmation.
     */
    public function submit(array $church,array $input,array $file,UploadService $upload,?string $memberId=null,?string $userId=null): array
    {
        $cid=(string)$church['id'];
        $key=trim((string)($input['request_key']??''));
        if (!preg_match('/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/D',$key)) throw new InvalidArgumentException('Atualize o formulário e tente novamente.');
        $stmt=$this->pdo->prepare('SELECT id FROM contribution_requests WHERE church_id=? AND request_key=?');
        $stmt->execute([$cid,$key]);
        if ($existing=$stmt->fetchColumn()) return ['id'=>$existing,'already'=>true];
        if (trim((string)($input['website']??''))!=='') throw new InvalidArgumentException('Envio inválido.');

        $date=trim((string)($input['transaction_date']??date('Y-m-d')));
        self::date($date);
        $today=date('Y-m-d');
        if ($date>$today || $date<date('Y-m-d',strtotime('-7 days'))) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Escolha hoje ou até sete dias anteriores.');
        }
        $value=self::parseAmount($input['amount']??'');
        $type=$this->item($cid,'type',trim((string)($input['type_id']??'')));
        $payment=$this->item($cid,'payment',trim((string)($input['payment_id']??'')));
        $reference=trim((string)($input['bank_reference']??''));
        if ($payment['requires_reference'] && $reference==='') {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Informe a referência do Pix ou da transferência.');
        }
        if (mb_strlen($reference)>190) throw new InvalidArgumentException('Referência muito longa.');
        $campaignId=trim((string)($input['campaign_id']??''))?:null;
        if ($type['requires_campaign'] && !$campaignId) throw new InvalidArgumentException('Selecione uma campanha vigente.');
        $campaignName='';
        if ($campaignId!==null) {
            $stmt=$this->pdo->prepare('SELECT name FROM contribution_campaigns WHERE id=? AND church_id=? AND active=1 AND start_date<=? AND (end_date IS NULL OR end_date>=?) AND (contribution_type_id IS NULL OR contribution_type_id=?)');
            $stmt->execute([$campaignId,$cid,$date,$date,$type['id']]);
            $campaignName=(string)$stmt->fetchColumn();
            if ($campaignName==='') throw new InvalidArgumentException('Campanha não está vigente nesta igreja.');
        }

        $name=trim((string)($input['contributor_name']??''));
        $notes=trim((string)($input['observation']??''));
        if (mb_strlen($name)>190 || mb_strlen($notes)>250) throw new InvalidArgumentException('Nome ou observação excedeu o limite.');
        if (!$type['allow_anonymous'] && $name==='' && $memberId===null)
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Este tipo de contribuição exige identificação do contribuinte.');
        if ($payment['requires_proof'] && (int)($file['error']??UPLOAD_ERR_NO_FILE)!==UPLOAD_ERR_OK)
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Esta forma de pagamento exige comprovante em foto ou PDF.');
        $ip=(string)($_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR']??'unknown');
        $ipHash=hash_hmac('sha256',$ip,$church['contribution_quick_token']);
        $stmt=$this->pdo->prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contribution_requests WHERE church_id=? AND ip_hash=? AND created_at>=DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 1 HOUR)');
        $stmt->execute([$cid,$ipHash]);
        if ((int)$stmt->fetchColumn()>=5) throw new RuntimeException('Limite temporário de envios atingido. Procure a Tesouraria.');

        $stored=$upload->financeDocument($file,$cid);
        $requestId=app_uuid();
        $entryId=app_uuid();
        $desc='Contribuição informada para conferência: '.$type['name'].($campaignName!==''?' - '.$campaignName:'');
        $desc=mb_substr($desc,0,255);
        if ($memberId!==null) {
            $stmt=$this->pdo->prepare('SELECT id FROM members WHERE id=? AND church_id=? AND active=1 LIMIT 1');
            $stmt->execute([$memberId,$cid]);
            if (!$stmt->fetchColumn()) $memberId=null;
        }
        $this->pdo->beginTransaction();
        try {
            $stmt=$this->pdo->prepare("INSERT INTO finance_entries(id,church_id,account_id,member_id,direction,income_kind,category,description,amount,transaction_date,status,source,created_by_user_id,payment_method,notes) VALUES(?,?,NULL,?,'income',?,?,?,?,?,'received','member_qr',?,?,?)");
            $stmt->execute([$entryId,$cid,$memberId,$type['code'],$type['name'],$desc,$value,$date,$userId,$payment['code'],$notes?:null]);
            $stmt=$this->pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO contribution_requests(id,church_id,finance_entry_id,request_key,contribution_type_id,payment_method_id,campaign_id,contributor_name,bank_reference,observation,ip_hash) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)');
            $stmt->execute([$requestId,$cid,$entryId,$key,$type['id'],$payment['id'],$campaignId,$name?:null,$reference?:null,$notes?:null,$ipHash]);
            if ($stored!==null) {
                $stmt=$this->pdo->prepare("INSERT INTO finance_documents(id,church_id,entry_id,payable_id,document_type,original_name,storage_path,mime_type,file_size,created_by_user_id) VALUES(?,?,?,NULL,'proof',?,?,?,?,?)");
                $stmt->execute([app_uuid(),$cid,$entryId,$stored['original_name'],$stored['path'],$stored['mime'],$stored['size'],$userId]);
            }
            $this->event($cid,$requestId,'submitted',null,'received',$userId,null);
            $this->pdo->commit();
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            if ($this->pdo->inTransaction()) $this->pdo->rollBack();
            if ($stored!==null && is_file($stored['absolute'])) @unlink($stored['absolute']);
            throw $e;
        }
        return ['id'=>$requestId,'already'=>false];
    }

    public function pending(string $churchId): array
    {
        $stmt=$this->pdo->prepare("SELECT r.*,e.amount,e.transaction_date,e.category,e.description,e.payment_method,
               (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM finance_documents d WHERE d.church_id=r.church_id AND d.entry_id=r.finance_entry_id) proof_count
            FROM contribution_requests r
            JOIN finance_entries e ON e.id=r.finance_entry_id AND e.church_id=r.church_id
            WHERE r.church_id=? AND r.status IN('received','reviewing')
            ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT 250");
        $stmt->execute([$churchId]);
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }

    public function entry(string $churchId,string $requestId): ?array
    {
        $stmt=$this->pdo->prepare('SELECT r.*,e.amount,e.transaction_date,e.category,e.description,e.payment_method,e.status ledger_status FROM contribution_requests r JOIN finance_entries e ON e.id=r.finance_entry_id AND e.church_id=r.church_id WHERE r.id=? AND r.church_id=? LIMIT 1');
        $stmt->execute([$requestId,$churchId]);
        return $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: null;
    }

    private function event(string $cid,string $id,string $action,?string $from,string $to,?string $user,string|null $comment): void
    {
        $this->pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO contribution_events(id,church_id,request_id,action,from_status,to_status,actor_user_id,comment) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)')
            ->execute([app_uuid(),$cid,$id,$action,$from,$to,$user,$comment]);
    }

    public function review(Auth $auth,string $cid,string $requestId,string $action,array $input): void
    {
        if (!$auth->can('finance') || (string)($auth->currentChurch()['id']??'')!==$cid) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Sem permissão para conferir contribuições.');
        }
        if (!in_array($action,['reviewing','reject','post'],true)) throw new InvalidArgumentException('Ação inválida.');
        $user=(string)$auth->requireLogin()['id'];
        $note=trim((string)($input['reviewer_notes']??''));
        if (mb_strlen($note)>1000) throw new InvalidArgumentException('Observação de até 1.000 caracteres.');
        $item=$this->entry($cid,$requestId);
        if (!$item || !in_array($item['status'],['received','reviewing'],true)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Solicitação não encontrada ou já finalizada.');
        }
        if ($action==='reject' && $note==='') throw new InvalidArgumentException('Informe o motivo da devolução.');
        $accountId=null;$depId=null;$costCenterId=null;
        if ($action==='post') {
            if ((string)($input['confirmed_received']??'')!=='yes') {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException('Confirme que o valor foi efetivamente localizado no caixa ou no extrato.');
            }
            $accountId=trim((string)($input['account_id']??''));
            if ($accountId==='') throw new InvalidArgumentException('Selecione a conta ou o caixa de destino.');
            $stmt=$this->pdo->prepare('SELECT id,department_id FROM finance_accounts WHERE id=? AND church_id=? AND active=1 LIMIT 1');
            $stmt->execute([$accountId,$cid]);
            $account=$stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            if (!$account) throw new RuntimeException('Conta inexistente, inativa ou de outra igreja.');
            $depId=$account['department_id'] ?: null;
            if ($depId!==null && !$auth->can('department_treasury')) {
                throw new RuntimeException('Este usuário não pode confirmar movimentações departamentais.');
            }
            $costCenterId=trim((string)($input['cost_center_id']??''))?:null;
            if ($costCenterId!==null) {
                $stmt=$this->pdo->prepare("SELECT id FROM church_registers WHERE id=? AND church_id=? AND kind='cost_center' AND active=1");
                $stmt->execute([$costCenterId,$cid]);
                if (!$stmt->fetchColumn()) throw new RuntimeException('Centro de custo não pertence a esta igreja.');
            }
            FinancePeriodGuard::assertOpen($this->pdo,$cid,(string)$item['transaction_date']);
        }

        $this->pdo->beginTransaction();
        try {
            $stmt=$this->pdo->prepare('SELECT status,finance_entry_id FROM contribution_requests WHERE church_id=? AND id=? FOR UPDATE');
            $stmt->execute([$cid,$requestId]);$row=$stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            if (!$row || !in_array($row['status'],['received','reviewing'],true)) {
                throw new RuntimeException('Solicitação já processada.');
            }
            $from=(string)$row['status'];
            $status=$action==='post'?'approved':($action==='reject'?'rejected':'reviewing');
            $stmt=$this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE contribution_requests SET status=?,reviewed_by_user_id=?,reviewed_at=NOW(),reviewer_notes=? WHERE id=? AND church_id=?');
            $stmt->execute([$status,$user,$note?:null,$requestId,$cid]);
            if ($action==='post') {
                $stmt=$this->pdo->prepare("UPDATE finance_entries SET status='posted',account_id=?,department_id=?,cost_center_id=? WHERE id=? AND church_id=? AND status='received'");
                $stmt->execute([$accountId,$depId,$costCenterId,$row['finance_entry_id'],$cid]);
                if ($stmt->rowCount()!==1) throw new RuntimeException('O lançamento já foi processado.');
            } elseif ($action==='reject') {
                $stmt=$this->pdo->prepare("UPDATE finance_entries SET status='rejected' WHERE id=? AND church_id=? AND status='received'");
                $stmt->execute([$row['finance_entry_id'],$cid]);
                if ($stmt->rowCount()!==1) throw new RuntimeException('O lançamento já foi processado.');
            }
            $this->event($cid,$requestId,$action,$from,$status,$user,$note?:null);
            $this->pdo->commit();
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            if ($this->pdo->inTransaction()) $this->pdo->rollBack();
            throw $e;
        }
    }
}
